name: Poundbury

dates.built: Under construction from 1993; due for completion 2028
dates.note: The node: 'under construction from 1993'; Wikipedia: land in the ducal estate west of Dorchester allocated for housing by West Dorset District Council in 1988, 'Due for completion in 2028'; the Duchy of Cornwall: 'Once complete in 2028, Poundbury will include 2,750 homes'. DPZ's 2024 newsletter says DPZ 'designed a code and regulating plan in 1989' for it -- Krier's masterplan and a DPZ code, which the node's prose does not mention.

refs.title: Poundbury - Wikipedia
refs.note: 'Under the direction of its lead architect and planner Léon Krier, its design is based on traditional architecture and New Urbanist philosophy. The 2021 census showed a population of 4,100.'

refs.title: Poundbury | Duchy of Cornwall
refs.note: Landowner and master developer. 'currently home to 5,000 people and over 260 businesses ... 35% of the homes being built are affordable'.

refs.title: Duchy of Cornwall - Wikipedia
refs.note: 'In 1988, West Dorset District Council allocated land in the ducal estate, west of Dorchester, for housing development, which became known as Poundbury.'

refs.title: DPZ Summer Newsletter 2024
refs.note: 'Poundbury, Dorchester, where DPZ designed a code and regulating plan in 1989'.

note: Written 4 Sep 2026. A town, not a building, on two nodes with one record. Wikipedia's population (4,100 at the 2021 census) and the Duchy's (5,000) are both on the record and dated differently.
